decisions.title: D1 GitHub Auth Strategy
decisions.question: Should the SIM-ONE Alpha coding worker use the managed GitHub device-flow auth system or switch to the official GitHub MCP server with a PAT (Personal Access Token)?

decisions.title: D2 Workspace Root Isolation
decisions.question: What single install-relative .gorombo runtime-root contract keeps packaged binaries, mutable state, persona files, and the coding-worker workspace correctly separated from source and process.cwd()?

decisions.title: D3 File Access Gate
decisions.question: Should the coding worker enforce a fail-closed file access gate that rejects any path outside the authorized workspace root and escalates to an approval gate for out-of-workspace access?

decisions.title: D4 Orchestrator History Visibility
decisions.question: Should the orchestrator have a tool to query coding worker tool-call history and filesystem state so it can verify what the worker actually did instead of trusting the worker's text response?

decisions.title: D5 Canonical Runtime Configuration
decisions.question: What single environment-file contract should source builds, packaged launchers, providers, connectors, workers, tools, onboarding, and Coding Worker configuration assistance use?

decisions.title: D6 TUI Approval Surface Placement
decisions.question: When an approval gate becomes pending, should the SIM-ONE TUI present the actionable selector as an overlay above the prompt or as a temporary dedicated approval row or panel while keeping the normal status surface at two rows?

decisions.title: D7 Separate Project And Task Lifecycle Graphs
decisions.question: Should one graph represent both repository development governance and the execution of an individual agent request?

decisions.title: D8 Extend The Memory Helper For Durable Task Runs
decisions.question: Where should durable task graph state live, given the existing Rust/WebAssembly Memory Helper already maintains project-scoped checklists, todos, notes, and task handoffs?

decisions.title: D9 Use A Flue-Native Application Graph Coordinator
decisions.question: Should SIM-ONE Alpha add LangGraph as a second agent runtime, use a Flue workflow as the graph scheduler, or build the task coordinator around Flue's existing agent surfaces?

decisions.title: D10 Seal Per-Node Context Envelopes
decisions.question: How should graph state manipulate model context without passing the complete conversation, project graph, workspace, retrieval store, and tool history into every agent node?

decisions.title: D11 Share One Graph Engine Across Orchestrator And Coding Worker
decisions.question: Should the main orchestrator and Coding Worker have unrelated task loops, or should they use one graph runtime with different definitions and private state?

decisions.title: D12 Flue 2 Persistence History And Compaction
decisions.question: How should Flue 2 persistence, beta conversation history, and the user-invoked compact command work without opening beta framework storage or recreating removed Flue APIs?
